IRGC: A giant vessel carrying LPG was struck and caught fire / Responsibility for escalating tensions in the region's maritime transport lies with the aggressor US military

🔹IRGC Navy: 220 nights of the epic of your million-strong presence, your steadfastness and perseverance in defending the world's truth and justice, have left [the world] in awe, call upon nations to play a role in reforming the state of the world, and are the most important divine support and a source of encouragement for the warriors of Islam.

🔹In carrying out this mission, hours ago a giant vessel carrying LPG named NV Sunshine, belonging to the Natwit company, which intended to pass through the illegal route south of the Strait of Hormuz, was struck and suffered a widespread fire in the engine room and propulsion system.

🔸Let everyone know that direct responsibility for these incidents and the escalation of tensions in the region's maritime transport lies with the aggressor US military, which, by interfering and deceiving the management of shipping companies and insurance companies and paying large bribes, causes such incidents — and with the continuation of these interventions, bitter incidents will increase day by day.

🔸Companies that fall for the deception of the American aggressors will be sanctioned, and necessary punitive measures will be applied to all vessels of violating companies.

🔸From now on, dealing with violating vessels will not be limited to the Strait of Hormuz, and any vessel that passes through an unauthorized route will be pursued throughout the region, and its punishment will be certain.

@Farsna

🔹In a clear pond, two ducks and a…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @FarsNA

A mouth that opened at the wrong time

🔹In a clear pond, two ducks and a turtle were neighbors, and a deep friendship and bond had formed between them. Time passed, and due to drought, the water in the pond began to dry up.

🔹The ducks, seeing that it was no longer possible to stay, came to the turtle to say goodbye and migrate to another body of water.

🔹The turtle lamented with sorrow and tears and said: "Waterlessness is far more dangerous for me, a slow-moving animal, than for you, and my life is impossible without any water. It is not the way of chivalry that you abandon me in this waterlessness; think of me and take me along with you."

🔹The ducks said: "Being apart from you is hard for us too, but you have a flaw: you take the advice of friends lightly and you don't shut your mouth at the right time!

🔹If you want us to take you too, there is one condition: we will bring a stick, we two will hold its two ends in our beaks, and you hold the middle of the stick firmly with your mouth so we can take flight. In the sky, no matter what people say and whatever shouts they raise, do not open your mouth!"

🔹The turtle promised and said: "I will obey and will not open my lips until the destination."

🔹The ducks brought the stick, the turtle gripped its middle firmly with its teeth, and they leapt into the air. As they were passing over a village, people's eyes fell on this amazing scene. An uproar rose among the people and they shouted: "Look! How the ducks are carrying the turtle through the air with a stick!"

🔹Hearing the clamor, the turtle could not endure it and became angry. Thinking it would say something to them, it opened its mouth and said: "May your eyes be blinded!"

🔹But as soon as it opened its lips, the stick was released from its mouth, and it fell from the height of the sky to the ground.

#حکایت@Farsna

Crossing the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorized route, as told by an Indian sailor
🔹An Indian sailor using the pseudonym "Singh" spoke with Fars and recounted his account of the GFS Galaxy crossing the Strait of Hormuz and being targeted.
🔹He said he used a pseudonym in the interview out of fear of legal action by the company that owns the ship.
🔸Singh says: The ship had to pass through Hormuz with the lights off. Radar off. Radio off. The captain had said not to turn on any communication device. Even senior sailors were not to use the radio.
🔸The route is a narrow strip near the coast of Oman. The sea depth is about 100 meters. The route is so narrow that large ships have almost no chance of getting through.
🔸The Omani route is no place for navigation because it is very narrow, the depth drops in places, and there are many rocks — and a mistake means death. Getting through here freely and safely is impossible, but no one tells the crew that.
🔸Before the crossing, the captain had told the crew: "The Americans have cleared the route and we are in constant contact; there is nothing to worry about." We had no choice either. We believed it.
🔸We were on the route when suddenly the ship was hit. The deck fell into chaos. The sound of an explosion. The ship shook. Everything in a few seconds.
🔸After the missile struck, the captain tried to contact the US Navy, but the responses came too late.
🔸The crew protested to the captain: "You said it was safe" and "you sent us to our deaths."
🔸We were told that America coordinates everything. But when the missile hit us, we realized America couldn't do a thing.
🔸The captain said America is there; but when the missile hit the ship, the big aircraft carriers just watched.
🔸Now I work as a laborer in a city. Even with 10 times more money, I am not willing to go back to those waters. My life is more important than money."

entry.title:
[FarsNA] The consequence of befriending deceivers
🔹A crow, a wolf, and a jackal…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @FarsNA

The consequence of befriending deceivers

🔹A crow, a wolf, and a jackal lived in a thicket alongside a lion, and they got by on the leftovers of his kills.

🔹One day, a camel that had fallen behind from a caravan came to that thicket to graze. When the camel came upon the lion, it bowed, and the lion granted it safety, saying it could live in peace under his protection.

🔹Some time later, the lion was badly wounded in a fight with an elephant, collapsed in his cave, and lost the strength to hunt. The animals around him were left helpless with hunger. The crow, looking for a way out, proposed to his companions that they find a way to get the lion to eat the camel.

🔹The jackal said, "The lion has granted him safety, and breaking one's word is shameful." The crow replied, "Leave it to me; I'll devise a scheme so the camel himself walks into being sacrificed."

🔹The crow went to the lion and, with smooth talk, won him over and promised to arrange things so that there would be no need to break the covenant.

🔹Then he went to the wolf, the jackal, and the camel and said, "The Sultan's life is in danger; come, let us show our loyalty and offer ourselves. The lion does not eat our flesh, but the custom of service is fulfilled."

🔹They all went to the lion. First the crow stepped forward and offered himself, but the wolf and the jackal cried out, "You're scrawny and your flesh tastes foul!" Then the jackal volunteered, and the others called his flesh stinking. It was the wolf's turn, and they deemed his flesh harmful.

🔹The simple-hearted camel, seeing this staging, thought to himself that if he too made an offer, the companions would, following the same custom as before, come up with some excuse and the lion's protection would hold. So he came forward and said, "My body is a sacrifice for the Sultan; my flesh is pure and will fill everyone." No sooner had he finished speaking than all three animals said with one voice, "He speaks the truth!" and immediately fell upon him and made him their prey.

#حکایت@Farsna

What are the consequences of fabricated polarizations for Iran?🔹Reducing the country's complex issues to binaries like "peace-seeking vs. warmongering" or "negotiation vs. war" can steer society away from a genuine conversation about national interests, costs, and foreign policy options.🔹Critics of this approach argue that negotiation should be a tool of foreign policy, not the only solution; just as defense and deterrence capabilities should not be equated with "warmongering."🔹The experience of the JCPOA and America's withdrawal from it has brought into sharper focus the debate over guaranteeing an agreement's implementation, reciprocal concessions, and preserving bargaining power. From this perspective, the core issue is not "negotiation or war," but preserving the power of choice and securing national interests.🔹False polarizations, rather than strengthening national cohesion, can deepen social divides; whereas in the face of external threats, internal cohesion, defense capability, economic strength, and active diplomacy can all serve national interests simultaneously.🔹Analysts believe that negotiation can help secure national interests when it is pursued from a position of choice, not out of compulsion and necessity. The experience of past agreements has also shown that an agreement alone, without guarantees of implementation and bargaining power, does not necessarily lead to a sustainable outcome.🔹When individuals and factions are categorized with labels like "warmonger" or "peacenik," the possibility of rational dialogue about details diminishes.🔹From the perspective of critics of polarization, a society that can discuss its differences while emphasizing shared national interests will have a greater capacity to manage foreign crises.@Farspolitics - link

🔹That is why one of the world's largest submarine cable contractors has officially declared force majeure for cable-laying operations in the region.

The case of the online gold dealer has reached the Supreme National Security Council

🔹The online gold sales platform Milli Gold, in a letter to Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, has called for an urgent order to lift restrictions on users' access to their gold held in bank vaults.

🔹The platform says restrictions imposed by the Economic Security Police and some related bodies have made it difficult to access part of its reserves and fulfill its obligations to users.

🔹In recent days, a number of Milli Gold users on social media have complained about delays in rial settlements and in receiving their physical gold. Some users have also raised concerns about the actual amount of gold backing the platform's transactions, alleging "selling empty."

🔹These concerns come as, under Central Bank regulations, online platforms must hold reserves equivalent to their obligations for gold sold, and the stored gold must be converted into standard bars with a purity of at least 995 within three months.

🔹Milli Gold, however, claims that existing governance mechanisms and bureaucracy have restricted its access to bank reserves, and that this has in turn disrupted the delivery of users' gold. The company had previously stated that users' gold is held in bank vaults.

🔸Now, given recent concerns about users' access to their gold and the claims raised about the backing of transactions, connecting all platforms to the supervisory system as quickly as possible — with online reporting of their inventory and obligations — has become more important than ever and could ease some of users' concerns.

🔹AI…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @FarsNA

False cheating accusations against students due to software errors

🔹AI detectors used to identify cheating among school and university students have come under scrutiny in new research for significant errors, in some cases mistakenly flagging completely human-written text as AI-generated.

🔹Investigations show these tools do not detect the true origin of the text; instead, they calculate the probability of AI-generated text based on statistical features and writing style.

🔹In one experiment, a completely human-written text was assessed by 5 commercial tools as anywhere from "zero percent" to "100 percent" AI-generated.

🔹These systems have also been reported to make more errors with people whose first language is not English; in a study of 91 real TOEFL essays, an average of 61 percent of human-written texts were mistakenly identified as AI-generated.

🔹Following these problems, universities such as Waterloo in Canada and Cape Town have stopped using Turnitin's AI detection score and have emphasized relying on evidence such as drafts, edit history, learning process, and conversations with the student.

@Farsna - Link

🔹A man took a fancy to becoming a thief, and to learn the trade professionally, he went to Nishapur, for he had heard that a skilled and seasoned thief lived there.

🔹When he entered the thief's house and stated his purpose, the master thief accepted him and took him on.

Netanyahu more isolated than ever at the UN🔹The atmosphere of the speeches delivered at the United Nations General Assembly shows that a colder reception than ever awaits Netanyahu.🔹World leaders in their own speeches at the UN General Assembly, even before Netanyahu's plane touched down, have directed sharp public criticism at the Zionist regime.🔹The mayor of New York had also previously threatened to arrest him. In addition, poll results show that Netanyahu now has fewer friends in both political parties in Washington.🔹2 American officials who asked not to be named have told the Wall Street Journal that Trump, Netanyahu's old friend, also has no plans to meet with him.🔹Even if Netanyahu wants to present this trip as an ordinary event, his mere presence at this meeting lays bare the diversity and breadth of his opponents in a country where Israel has placed its greatest bets.@Farsna - Link
